decision.statement: Which change to the donation ask or the donation page would most increase recurring monthly giving this quarter, in a way donors can trust?
evidence_required: How the donation ask compares against benchmark charities pursuing the same donor
What proof of impact a donor sees before being asked to give

Existing one-time donors deciding whether to convert to recurring

exclusions: Major gifts and corporate partnerships, which are relationship-managed off-page
